Purchase a license for unlimited downloads at the product page linked above. 67: 68: ## FAQ 69: 70: **How do I download a Udemy video** 71: Log in to Udemy in your browser, navigate to a lecture page in a course you are enrolled in, then click the download button on the player or the extension icon. Select the lectures you want and click Download All to queue them. 75: 76: **What quality options are available** 77: The extension automatically selects the best available quality — up to 4K (2160p). Available resolutions depend on what Udemy provides for each lecture. 78: 79: **What format are downloaded videos** 80: All videos save as standard MP4 files that play on any device or media player. 81: 82: **Do I need to be enrolled in the course** 83: Yes. You must be enrolled (free or paid) in the course to download its lectures. The extension uses your active Udemy session. 84: 85: **Why does it say the content is DRM-protected** 86: Some Udemy courses use digital rights management to prevent downloads. These videos cannot be downloaded by any browser extension. The extension will notify you when this is the case. 87: 88: **Does this work on Firefox** 89: Yes. It supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Whale, Yandex, and Firefox. 90: 91: **Is my Udemy account safe** 92: Yes. The extension reads your existing Udemy login session — it never stores or transmits your Udemy credentials. Extension authentication uses secure one-time-password verification with no passwords stored. 93: 94: ## Notes (important) 95: 96: This extension is intended for downloading content from courses you are enrolled in. Users are responsible for ensuring they have the right to download content and for respecting Udemy's terms of service and content creators' rights. Quality depends on the source video.
